summary.title: Professional Summary
summary.text: Mobile & Full Stack Developer with 4+ years of experience building production web and mobile applications. Experienced with React Native, Flutter, Kotlin, Compose, React, and TypeScript, with a focus on mobile development, maintainable code, and user experience. Currently deepening my expertise in Flutter, mobile architecture, and backend development.

roles.title: Full Stack Developer
points: Led end-to-end business features across frontend and backend services, integrating REST APIs, VTEX, internal platforms, and third-party systems for a high-traffic e-commerce platform.
Led the technical implementation of the online credit application flow, including biometric identity validation and the complete frontend experience.
Led the continuous evolution of checkout, covering cart management, payment, shipping, and order confirmation.
Refactored and modularized legacy monolithic applications, improving maintainability, scalability, and development velocity.
Contributed to software architecture, BFFs, microservices, event-driven communication, Clean Architecture, CI/CD, code reviews, and technical planning.

roles.title: Mobile Developer
points: Developed and maintained production mobile applications using React Native, Flutter, and Compose for products reaching more than 20 million users worldwide.
Built end-to-end mobile features integrating REST APIs, Firebase, and local storage.
Improved performance, stability, and maintainability by resolving production issues, optimizing critical flows, and refactoring legacy code.
Contributed to software architecture, code reviews, Agile ceremonies, and engineering best practices across multiple projects.

roles.title: UX/UI Designer
points: Designed user-centered mobile interfaces and flows for Android and iOS, collaborating with developers on implementation and reusable design systems.

roles.title: Programming Instructor
points: Designed and evolved the curriculum for a university-level Diploma in Game Development, covering programming, software engineering, and game development.
Taught programming with Godot and C#, developed project-based materials, and mentored students through complete software projects.
